metadata.title: Equal dilatations deep in the Johnson filtration: a convex-core proof
metadata.description:
For every fixed closed oriented surface of genus g at least 2 and every fixed finite Johnson depth k at least 3, we prove that pseudo-Anosov log-dilatation multiplicities in I_g(k), counted up to conjugacy in the full orientation-preserving mapping class group, are unbounded. This gives a negative answer to Farb's Question 7.6. A deep commutator with an explicit hyperbolic derivative yields a fixed Schottky subgroup. A compact convex core bounds conjugacy fusion inside any discrete Fuchsian overgroup, and Horowitz's universal equal-trace families supply arbitrarily many ambient classes at one common dilatation.

The same negative answer is recorded in Alper Ferudun's 11 October 2026 preprint, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23301731, which is explicitly credited. This note presents an alternative convex-core proof and makes no claim of firstness, a new existence theorem, a new mechanism, or current worldwide openness. Public-disclosure ordering and the relationship between the same-day candidate and that preprint remain unestablished. Powers are included; no ambient primitivity, simple-geodesic, single-value infinite-multiplicity, or intersection-of-all-depths claim is made. The deposit contains the paper and a portable TeX-source, complete written-proof, finite exact-diagnostic, independent-adversarial-review, integrity-verification and bounded-priority archive. Finite computations are consistency checks, not proof certificates for the infinite theorem. AI tools were used extensively in research, proof development, literature review, internal adversarial verification and writing. Unrefereed; no external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.
